results.claim: Overlay-1's static lit path uses DM[6].xyz as the dot-product direction, clamps the dot product at zero, scales it by DM[5].xyz, adds the distinct ambient vector DM[4].xyz, multiplies by vf05.xyz, converts with FTOI0, and stores at output qword vi04+1.
Overlay-1 subtracts LOI 98304 from the input +1 XYZ and conditionally calls BAL vi15,+459 when vi14 is nonzero; the target/effect is outside the inspected overlay listing.
FUN_0021c3e0's param_5 bit-8-clear branch emits STROW 0x47c00000 for XYZ, STMOD 1, then a V4-8 REF with USN clear, while the alternative bit-8-set branch does not establish this order.
Under the pinned PCSX2 VIF mode-1 and signed V4-8 unpack semantics, float32(bitcast_u32(0x47c00000 + s))-98304.0 equals s/128 exactly for every signed byte s from -128 through 127.
The available evidence proves that the FUN_0021c3e0 normalized V4-8 path and overlay-1 generated the sampled COBRA RGB packets.
